reuse.why: Extends getFillableCategories, the selection that copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the forEachBulkCategory-based actions already use.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is defined once (FIXED_TAG plus a join in the shared query).

placement.why: Stays in budget/actions.ts in the shared selection function, with its doc comment updated.

scope.why: Only the selection, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear and central; the tag regex is a bit dense but commented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action takes its categories from getFillableCategories.

one_place.where: getFillableCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and forEachBulkCategory (setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg).
